items.title: Datasentinel 2026.10 released with AI Connector
items.snippet: Datasentinel 2026.10, the new release of our PostgreSQL monitoring and troubleshooting platform, is now available. It introduces AI Connector, which connects Datasentinel metrics to the AI assistant your team already uses. Ask a question in plain language, such as "why was the orders database slow at 9:00 this morning?". The assistant analyzes the collected data, explains what it finds and turns…
items.summary: Datasentinel 2026.10 has been released with a new AI Connector for PostgreSQL monitoring. PostgreSQL teams using Datasentinel are affected. Try the new release through your Datasentinel update channel.

items.summary: An exposed Fireworks AI access key led to a breach of Anthropic's official Claude Code extension on Cursor's extension marketplace. Cursor users and developers integrating these AI tools are affected. Review extension permissions and rotate any compromised API keys.

items.title: All AI-generated code should be Open Source
items.summary: Opinion piece discussing whether AI-generated code should be open source, affecting software developers and legal perspectives. Read the article for more insights.

items.title: FBI warns ARTEX AI hacking tool is powering global cyberattacks
items.snippet: The FBI is warning that hackers are using an AI-powered penetration testing framework called ARTEX to automate cyberattacks against organizations worldwide, including a recent ConnectWise supply-chain breach that compromised Microsoft 365 customer environments. [...]
items.summary: The FBI warns that hackers are using the ARTEX AI penetration testing tool to automate global cyberattacks, including a ConnectWise supply-chain breach. Review your Microsoft 365 environments and access controls.

items.title: Microsoft 365 outage leads to chlorine gas poisoning of 15 hotel guests
items.summary: A Microsoft 365 outage indirectly contributed to a chlorine gas poisoning incident involving 15 hotel guests. Monitor Microsoft service health dashboards for updates.
